claims: The 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Elite Eight games are scheduled for Saturday, March 28, and Sunday, March 29.
The 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Elite Eight games are at regional sites in San Jose, Chicago, and Washington, D.C.
Saturday, March 28, 6:09 p.m. ET: #9 Iowa vs. #3 Illinois (Toyota Center, Houston) - TBS/TruTV in the 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Elite Eight.
Saturday, March 28, 8:49 p.m. ET: #2 Purdue vs. #1 Arizona (SAP Center, San Jose) - TBS/TruTV in the 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Elite Eight.
The matchups and times for Sunday, March 29 Elite Eight games in the 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament will be finalized following the remaining Sweet 16 games.
The Sunday, March 29 Elite Eight games in the 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament will be broadcast on TBS/truTV.
The winners of the 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Elite Eight will advance to the Final Four in Indianapolis on April 4.
